summary: Political rivalry between RSS/VHP and CPI(M) leading to hartal violence; prosecution witnesses' credibility examined; material contradictions in testimony assessed under Rammi vs State of MP; postmortem reports confirming homicidal deaths; recovery of weapons under Section 27 IEA; FIR timing and authenticity challenged; eyewitness accounts scrutinized for political bias; conviction of A1-A3, A11-A12 upheld for murder under IPC 302 r/w 149 and Explosive Substances Act 5; acquittal of A4-A10, A13-A15 confirmed.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment confirming conviction of A1-A3, A11-A12 upheld; acquittal of A4-A10, A13-A15 confirmed.
